messages:
alex (SE): Quick handoff for the Peregrine POC pipeline integration. Goal: staging smoke Thu, UAT Fri, cutover Mon. Need sign-off on SSO cert + payload schema by EOD Wed. Owners: maya (customer), ravi (eng), jordan (platform). Any blockers?

maya (AE): Ack — I'll confirm cert with customer and infra today. Also customer asked for allowed IPs for the dedicated pool.

ravi (eng): Heads-up: I opened a PR for the pipeline adapter, small config change + feature flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/452 — needs CR from @jordan and @sara. Added flag `enable_assume_role`.

jordan (platform): :eyes: Will review tomorrow AM. Quick Q — does this change the container image tag? If so we need to plan a canary deploy.

sara (prod): It bumps base image to alb-optimizer:2.1 (minor). Recommend canary on dedicated pool first, then roll to staging if metrics look good.

alex (SE): Customer is fine with canary. Success criteria for cutover: 1) end-to-end inference within 300ms p95 on dedicated pool; 2) no 5xxs on 10k sample traffic; 3) all auth flows validated with SSO token.

maya (AE): I'll run auth validation with customer on Thu after canary. Please drop sample token payloads to me by EOD.

ravi (eng): Putting the sample payloads here: ```{\n  "sub": "user:123",\n  "exp": 1710000000,\n  "scopes": ["inference:invoke"]\n}``` Also note the adapter logs now emit `routing.debug` for prefix hits — useful for perf checks.

jordan (platform): CI shows a lint failure on the PR, left a comment. After that I'll do full review. Also scheduling a canary window: Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC. @sara can you setup monitoring alerts for p95>350ms and error rate >0.5% during window?

sara (prod): Will do. Alert runbook: page on p95>500ms, otherwise Slack notify at 0.5%.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 2026-04-09T03:00:00Z (canary). CI: passed for commit abc123, awaiting approvals.

alex (SE): Action items: 1) @ravi address lint + merge PR; 2) @jordan review + approve; 3) @sara create alerts and dashboard; 4) @maya confirm cert + IP allowlist with customer. We'll reconvene async here — ping if anything slips. :thumbsup:
